questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion with the passive voice and a conditional clause to express a hypothetical scenario where the result would not have occurred?
options: It was only when she had finished her report that she realised she had missed the deadline.
Had she not spent so long on her research, she would have completed the project sooner.
By the time he arrived, the meeting had already been postponed twice.
She was so tired that she couldn’t concentrate, which is why she failed the exam.
questions.answer: Had she not spent so long on her research, she would have completed the project sooner.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a cleft construction to emphasize the subject of a complex clause, where the focus is on the person who caused the situation?
options: The fact that he was late was entirely his own fault.
It was John who persuaded everyone to cancel the trip.
The reason she left early was because she had a meeting.
What surprised me most was that he had forgotten our anniversary.
questions.answer: It was John who persuaded everyone to cancel the trip.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a third conditional with the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation that is unreal and distant from the present?
options: If she had known the rules better, she would have won the competition.
If he had studied more, he would be a doctor by now.
If they had arrived earlier, they would have seen the performance live.
If she had been more patient, she wouldn’t have given up so quickly.
questions.answer: If she had known the rules better, she would have won the competition.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the use of ellipsis in a formal context, where a repeated phrase is omitted for stylistic conciseness?
options: She apologised, ‘I’m sorry I kept you waiting.’
He said, ‘The meeting is cancelled; there’s no need to worry.’
They discussed the project, but only one person had a clear idea of what needed to be done.
After reviewing the data, it was clear that the results were inconclusive.
questions.answer: He said, ‘The meeting is cancelled; there’s no need to worry.’

questions.question: Which sentence uses a complex structure with a formal register to express a nuanced contrast between two conditions, where one is more likely than the other?
options: Although the weather was terrible, they decided to go hiking anyway.
Had he not been so distracted, he would have passed the exam effortlessly.
In spite of her exhaustion, she managed to complete the report on time.
Unless you provide more evidence, we will have to conclude that your claim is unfounded.
questions.answer: Unless you provide more evidence, we will have to conclude that your claim is unfounded.
